B2B business onboarding

Supplier registration

The Connect Pharma is intended for pharmaceutical businesses. Supplier account creation is limited to the distributor role. After email verification, submit a current wholesale Drug Licence and GST certificate through KYC for manual administrative review.

Email verification is not business verification. Document review does not certify a licence with a government registry or replace your legal obligations. Suppliers are responsible for accurate product details, maintaining required records, and supplying regulated medicines only to appropriately authorised buyers.
